subject: general
question: Which of the following films was selected as India's official entry for Oscar 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Laapataa Ladies**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Laapataa Ladies** has been selected as **India's official entry** for the **Oscar Awards 2025** in the Best International Feature Film category.
 
• The film is directed by **Kiran Rao**, who is known for her unique storytelling and creative approach to filmmaking.
 
• **Laapataa Ladies** is a Hindi-language drama that explores themes of **gender, identity, and societal norms** in rural India.
 
• The film is set in the **1990s** and follows the story of two young brides who go missing during a train journey, leading to a search filled with humor and heartfelt moments.
 
• It is produced under the banner of **Aamir Khan Productions**, ensuring high production quality and wide reach.
 
• The movie premiered at the **Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF)** and received critical acclaim for its storytelling and performances.
 
• This selection highlights India's commitment to showcasing **diverse narratives** and promoting regional stories on the global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Jawan**__

 __
 
• **Jawan** is a blockbuster action-thriller film directed by **Atlee** and starring **Shah Rukh Khan**.
 
• The film focuses on themes of **vigilantism** and social justice but was not selected for the Oscars as it primarily caters to a commercial audience.
 
 
 
• **Animal**__
 __
 
• **Animal** is an upcoming action-drama film directed by **Sandeep Reddy Vanga** and starring **Ranbir Kapoor**.
 
• The film explores complex relationships, especially between a father and son, but it is yet to be released and hence was not eligible for Oscar consideration.
 
 
 
• **12th Fail**__
 
 
• **12th Fail** is an inspirational film directed by **Vidhu Vinod Chopra**, based on the struggles of a student preparing for competitive exams in India.
 
• Though it delivers a strong social message, it did not make it as India's official Oscar entry.
